name: sub_pedal
character: One low, slowly bending pedal under everything, the weight of the hole rather than a bass line: it never stops and never hurries.
description: The floor: a synth bass pedal on the chord root two octaves under the low strings, changing every two bars, held through every section and left alone at the final D.
sources: KB cinematic-hybrid-scoring section 1 | a held pedal point keeps even dissonant chords coherent and carries the pressure without a groove
KB soundfont-velocity-and-realism section 4 | velocity_timbre bands keep the soft pedal from sounding brighter than the loud one; starting values
ESTIMATE: azimuth -8 deg, 4.0 m, gain -6 dB, HP 36 Hz (the 26 Hz pedal sat in the sub-sonic band and beat against the master) and LP 420 Hz are starting values for a sub pedal in a very large field
